name: Teaching Dimension of Chen–Cheng–Tang Teaching Products
details: For every integer $n\ge1$; $n$ is the number of twelve-coordinate blocks. The ratio $\mathrm{RTD}/\mathrm{VC}=5/3$ is constant, despite the growing additive gap.
proof: The database's minimum-teaching value proof for this family establishes that every product target, not merely an easiest target, has minimum teaching size $5n$. Taking the maximum over targets gives teaching dimension $5n$.
references: \cite{chen2016recursive}, Section 3 and Figure 4; \cite{doliwa2014recursive}, Lemma 16. Definition-driven finite verification: sync/verify_chen_teaching_products.py and sync/chen_teaching_products.json.
